bibl.title: Eine demotische Version des Töpferorakels? Der Papyrus Berlin P 23888+Wien D 9906b, c recto.
bibl.seg: 141.2 P. Berol. Inv. 23888 + P. Vindob. Dem. Inv. 9906b-c
Martin Andreas Stadler, Eine demotische Version des Töpferorakels? Der Papyrus Berlin P 23888+Wien D 9906b, c recto.
Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Πολυμάθεια. Studi Classici offerti a Mario Capasso (Lecce, 2018) pp. 395-411, figg.
bibl.note: P. Berol. Inv. 23888 + P. Vindob. Dem. Inv. 9906b-c. Fragments of a political horoscope that connects prophecies of misfortune imminent to Egypt with certain astronomical constellations. E.A.E. Reymond's previous classification of the text in a preliminary report of hers [P. Rainer Cent., p. 50] as Egyptian "pattern-composition" that, translated to Greek, resulted in the Potter's Oracle does not withstand closer investigation.
